A.action_priority_reason: This context has the strongest combined domain, composite, or facet evidence, so it is the most useful place to seek observable feedback first.

B.action_priority_reason: This context has the strongest combined domain, composite, or facet evidence, so it is the most useful place to seek observable feedback first.

C.notice_title: Treat this report as a current signal to verify
C.notice_body: Your response state may have affected some scores. The report uses qualified language and should be checked against recent real situations rather than treated as a fixed identity.
C.notice_why: Response consistency or completion signals did not support strong claims.
C.retest_label: Retake when your state is steady
C.interpretation_qualifier: Based on this response pattern, this interpretation may fit; use real situations to keep testing it.
C.action_priority_reason: The current evidence supports observing this context first; record feedback before expanding the action.

D.notice_title: Low-confidence result — a retake is recommended
D.notice_body: The current response signal is not strong enough for stable personality conclusions. This report only describes directions this response pattern may resemble and keeps actions low-risk, reversible, and observational.
D.notice_why: Consistency, response pace, or valid-response indicators did not reach the interpretation threshold. This does not mean there is anything wrong with your personality.
D.retest_label: Retake when you can answer steadily
D.interpretation_qualifier: This response pattern may be closer to the following description, but the evidence is too limited to treat it as a stable identity.
D.action_intro_body: Because confidence is low, this section shows only low-effort, reversible Start and Observe actions. It does not invent Continue or Stop cards to fill every bucket.
D.action_priority_reason: Low-confidence results keep only reversible start and observe actions. Priority means this context is most useful to track, not that it calls for a strong prescription.

UNKNOWN.notice_title: Quality status unavailable — read cautiously and retake
UNKNOWN.notice_body: The system cannot verify the quality grade, so the report uses the lowest-confidence policy and avoids fixed identity claims.
UNKNOWN.notice_why: A verifiable quality state is missing.
UNKNOWN.interpretation_qualifier: The available information is only a tentative clue and should not be treated as a stable conclusion.
UNKNOWN.action_intro_body: When quality cannot be verified, only Observe actions are shown; other buckets are not fabricated.
UNKNOWN.action_priority_reason: When quality is unknown, only observation actions are retained.

norm_evidence.percentile_explanation: For example, the 20th percentile means the current score is higher than about 20% of the reference group. It does not mean 20% correct or 20% ability.
norm_evidence.unavailable_explanation: The runtime cannot verify the reference sample, version, sample size, and comparison group together, so precise percentile claims are withheld.
